title: Write a claude-sub step-down to the run feed, not only the Worker console
description:
The worker door's step-down is a console.log in claudeSubLeaseForBoot. Spike jvj asked the run feed to say 'claude-sub exhausted until <reset>; on Workers AI'. Without that line, a claude-config run that quietly ran on GLM reads as a claude run in status and watch.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts claudeSubLeaseForBoot
